commands: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin ui/radar-details-redesign main agent-control; git checkout ui/radar-details-redesign; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d107dad886894f0e8e663f53006d11e0f9910f4f"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/ui/radar-details-redesign)" = "d107dad886894f0e8e663f53006d11e0f9910f4f"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "093b4257859abdbcc683f1620969b06195ade7a6"; echo P2C_V20_BASELINE_OK

set -euo pipefail; echo '--- RELEVANT FILES ---'; git ls-files | grep -Ei '(^|/)(scripts?|tools?|perf|benchmark|scenario|fixture|seed|adb|acceptance|baseline|ui_ux|phase2|phase3)' | head -n 250 || true; echo '--- HARNESS MATCHES ---'; rg -n -i --glob '!**/build/**' --glob '!**/.gradle/**' --glob '!**/.git/**' '(120[ -]?(item|device)|100\+|long[- ]list|gfxinfo|framestats|adb (shell|install)|seed(ed|ing)?|fixture|benchmark|performance scenario|controlled.*device)' docs scripts tools .github app core feature 2>/dev/null | head -n 350 || true; echo '--- APP ID ---'; rg -n 'applicationId|namespace' app/build.gradle.kts app/build.gradle 2>/dev/null || true

set -euo pipefail; echo '--- ADB DEVICES ---'; adb devices -l; serial=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$serial"; echo ADB_SERIAL=$serial; echo MODEL=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo MANUFACTURER=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r'); echo ANDROID=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'); echo SDK=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); echo '--- BLUEEYE PACKAGES ---'; adb -s "$serial" shell pm list packages | tr -d '\r' | grep -Ei 'blueeye|tracker' || true; echo '--- TOP ACTIVITY ---'; adb -s "$serial" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true

set -euo pipefail; echo '--- PHASE2 DOC EXCERPTS ---'; for f in docs/UI_UX_PHASE2_HANDOFF_2026-09-12.md docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md docs/UI_UX_BASELINE_P0_2026-09-12.md docs/PHASE3_TARGETED_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE.md; do if test -f "$f"; then echo "### $f"; rg -n -i -C 4 '(120|100\+|long[- ]list|gfxinfo|framestats|performance|seed|device)' "$f" | head -n 180 || true; fi; done; echo P2C_V20_INSPECT_DONE
